description: This is a Python script implementing a linter for GitHub Actions workflows, specifically checking for 'no_workflows_on_fork' rules related to repository ownership and trigger conditions.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enum representing severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lint message with details such as path, code, severity, and description.

methods.name: load_yaml
methods.description: Loads a YAML file from the given path using a safe loader.

methods.name: gen_lint_message
methods.description: Creates a LintMessage object with specified parameters, defaulting to a 'NO_WORKFLOWS_ON_FORK' error.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Analyzes a workflow YAML file to identify jobs missing 'if' conditions that check for repository owner 'pytorch' and generates corresponding lint messages.
